moveEffects.name: Feint
moveEffects.originalDescription: Dash in an arc, attacking enemies that come in contact with Absol. This move ignores the defense stat and shield effects of enemies. The user dashes in an arc forward, damaging Pokémon in the path and increasing the user's basic attack speed by 60% for 0.5s when this move hits. This move ignores the Defense and shield effects of Pokémon hit. Each use alternates between a rightward and leftward arc.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Midnight Slash
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front of the user. This move ends by unleashing powerful blades of energy, dealing increased damage to enemies and shoves them. The user briefly becomes unstoppable before becoming untargetable and invulnerable for 1.15s while unleashing a flurry of 5 slashes in front of themself in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The user then becomes unstoppable again and unleashes a final slash in front of them with 3 blades of energy, shoving opposing Pokémon and dealing damage, up to 4 times at close range and down to 1 time at maximum range. The damage of the flurry of 5 slashes is divided by the number of targets hit. The first hit from the final slash deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent hits deal 30% of the full damage to the same target. Unite buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
